genius.notes: The BMA Class M license is a foreign digital-asset business license, not GENIUS approval or a registered foreign-issuer exception. Current VNX Global Ltd terms identify the issuer and cover VCHF; current transparency contracts match tracked VCHF. Older VNX Commodities AG records describe the prior structure. Terms disclose reserve categories, restrict direct minting/redemption to verified sophisticated Organizations, specify a CHF 100,000 minimum issuance request, and permit delayed or in-kind redemption under stated conditions; the issuance threshold is not asserted to be a redemption minimum. Supply figures on the checked transparency page are marked mock data and no signed monthly attestation reports are publicly linked despite a monthly-audit description. GENIUS remains pre-effective; Treasury expects January 18, 2027, subject to the enacted earlier-final-rule trigger. The September 30 SCRC procedural rule is not issuer qualification or an earlier commencement rule; the July 18, 2028 DASP deadline is separate.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No public PPSI approval, qualified-state approval, official GENIUS application, registered foreign-issuer exception or GENIUS enforcement action naming VNX Global Ltd/VCHF was located in these bounded checks on October 7, 2026. BMA and current contractual disclosures establish the foreign issuer, not U.S. qualification. The OCC table covers digital-asset bank applications and is not an exhaustive GENIUS issuer register. A foreign-exception finding cannot be inferred from a Bermuda license. Treasury expects January 18, 2027 effectiveness, subject to the statute's earlier-final-rule trigger; the SCRC procedural IFR does not itself commence the issuer regime.
